# Lumen Gotchas

> Known Lumen NaaS API patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Price-qualify endpoint rejects partnerId alongside masterSiteId](price-qualify-partnerid-422.md): /Product/v1/price 422s if partnerId is sent with masterSiteId; qualify location-only, quote needs partnerId for DC circuits. HIGH.
